stalls.summaryZh: 老夫妻經營，口味有紅豆、草莓、花生、奶油，價格便宜到誇張，常大排長龍。
stalls.summaryEn: Run by an elderly couple with red bean, strawberry, peanut and butter fillings at rock-bottom prices; lines are common.

sources.title: 台南吃貨愛吃輝：灣裡夜市

stalls.summaryZh: 份量大、湯頭藥香溫和，老闆親切，可以當正餐。
stalls.summaryEn: Big portions of gently herbal rib soup and a friendly owner; enough for a full meal.

stalls.summaryZh: 甜鹹滷汁炸過，冷了也不油膩，價格比市區便宜，常要排隊。
stalls.summaryEn: Braised-then-fried duck with a sweet-savoury glaze that stays good cold; cheaper than downtown and often queued for.

sources.title: 台南吃貨愛吃輝：灣裡夜市

stalls.summaryZh: 花生醬香濃、玉米不乾，常整批烤完就賣光。
stalls.summaryEn: Peanut-rich glaze on moist corn; batches tend to sell out.

sources.title: 台南吃貨愛吃輝：灣裡夜市

stalls.summaryZh: 中藥香氣濃，生意好所以油新，有網友認為是台南最好吃的三角骨之一。
stalls.summaryEn: Strong herbal aroma and fresh oil thanks to high turnover; one local blogger rates it among Tainan's best.

sources.title: 台南吃貨愛吃輝：灣裡夜市
